items.question: Which corners of the diagram receive the joined kṛṣṇa-cakra?
premises: It states the kṛṣṇa-cakra is joined there.
The corners are fire demon wind and shambhu.
items.inference: The joined kṛṣṇa-cakra is placed in those four corners.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of kṛṣṇa-cakra is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: It is joined in the fire, demon, wind, and Shambhu corners.
